findings.claim: On the Aug 8 sandbox day (deal #186,441,603, gold = one-big-move) the Gold HUD chip flips to a green check the instant a 6-card run is relocated, but a single tap of Undo un-earns it: the chip drops back to '·'. Game.swift's undo() restores telem.maxRunMoved from the move snapshot, so the objective WORKFLOWS.md WF-13 and Daily.swift:426 both call 'positive + irreversible: locked in the moment it happens' is in fact reversible, while telem.undos (the negative no-undo objective) is deliberately never rolled back — an inconsistency that can silently cost a player the Gold medal.

repro: tap Play (200,490)  -> Deal #186441603, HUD shows Clear/96 moves/Move a run of 5+
tap Auto-play pill (335,135) to set Auto-play: Off (keeps the board deterministic)
run the 19 setup drags in .qa-loop/scratch/qa-worker-2/search5.mjs output (node .qa-loop/scratch/qa-worker-2/search5.mjs 186441603) to reach Moves 19
drag (224,602) -> (28,650): moves the 6-card run 7C 6H 5C 4H 3C 2H from col4 onto 8H at col0 -> Moves 20, Gold chip turns green with a checkmark
tap Undo (142,135) -> Moves 19 and the Gold chip reverts to '·'

findings.note: TRAP: the obvious fix (stop rolling telem.maxRunMoved back in Game.swift undo(), ~line 445) is what WF-13 asks for, but it lets a player 'peek' — make a 5+ run move, undo it immediately, and keep Gold without ever committing the move. Decide deliberately whether the medal is earned by the ACT or by the final line, and keep the rule consistent with telem.undos (never rolled back) and with save/restore.

findings.claim: Tapping the Daily card's gold `Play` while a daily attempt is already in progress re-deals the board and throws the attempt away with no confirmation and no hint on the card that one is live — even when it is the SAME day you are playing. The identical loss via a 'Show me how to win' pill IS gated by an 'End your daily attempt?' alert, so the app protects the rarer path and not the common one.

repro: tap Daily, tap calendar day 7 (307,723), tap Play (200,490) -> Deal #942660922, HUD up
make 4 real moves (drag (28,715)->(126,650); drag (126,692)->(77,650); drag (272,685)->(276,370); drag (272,655)->(28,370)) -> Moves 4, Silver and Gold chips show red x, clock running
tap Daily (315,175) -> the sheet opens on TODAY's card, with no sign that an Aug 7 attempt is live
tap calendar day 7 (307,723) -> Aug 7 card, plain gold `Play` (no 'resume'/'in progress' state)
tap Play (200,490) -> board re-deals: Moves 0, Time 0:00, Undo disabled, HUD chips reset. No alert, no undo path back.

findings.note: Also seen across days: an Aug 8 attempt at Moves 19 / 7:51 was discarded the same way by picking Aug 7 -> Play. Minimal fix is to reuse the existing 'End your daily attempt?' alert (challengeDay != nil && moveCount > 0) on the day-card Play path; the alternative ('Play' resumes the live attempt, or the card shows 'Resume') is a design call for the human. TRAP: whichever is chosen must not create a way to restart a daily for a better time while keeping the earlier attempt's banked telemetry.
